# docs/memory/visitors/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

Visitor statistics, page and article views, search engine index flags.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Take a visitor figure from `includes/fn/visitor_figures.php` (totals, breakdown, traffic, content), never a raw count of `visitors` rows: it reads the daily summary where it covers and the raw rows only for the rest (`visitor-figures-module.md`).
- Build reports from the summary tables (`visitor_stats_hourly`, `visitor_content_hourly`), never by counting raw `visitors` rows (`visitor-rollup-tables.md`).
- Aggregate a busy counter at write time with one `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` on a sha1 bucket key; never put the query string in the key (`high-volume-counter-rules.md`).
- Sum aggregated rows (`SUM(page_views)`, `SUM(hit_count)`); both visitor summary tables must count the same thing (`visitor-rollup-consistency.md`).
- Treat summary tables as derived data: when one is wrong, TRUNCATE it and rebuild from the source; a bucket cannot be fixed in place (`visitor-rollup-consistency.md`).
- Split a long backfill into resumable steps: a time budget, a cursor saved after each chunk, the backfill's own MySQL time zone (`visitor-rollup-backfill-runtime.md`).
- Make every query that reads the page sitemap flag also read noindex; `sitemap = 1` and `noindex = 1` never go together (`page-noindex-switch.md`).
- Write a new page field from all four page screens (`add_page`, `edit_page`, `add/edit_system_style`); saving from another one drops it (`page-noindex-switch.md`).
- Write a noindex page into robots.txt as three anchored lines, never a plain prefix, and never write a private-folder page there (`robots-txt-disallow-rules.md`).
- Never assume a page renders an HTML document: a new splice or document rule first checks that the output is one (`seo-structure-non-html-output.md`).
- Give every action link (login, register, reset, subscribe, remove from cart) `rel="nofollow"`, stamped by the server in system widgets (`action-links-rel-nofollow.md`).
- Offer a translated address in sitemap.xml or hreflang only by `pg_tr_index_decide()`; no kept answer means not offered, only a reviewed write keeps one, and the verdict counts only the page's own words, never a list's records or the catalog (`translation-index-verdict.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->

## Files

- `INDEX.md` lists the 50 files of this folder, one line each: search it rather than read it whole, then open only the files that match.
- `grep -i 'word' docs/memory/visitors/INDEX.md`; across every folder: `grep -i 'word' docs/memory/*/INDEX.md`.
